titulo: The Day We Found Our Echo
tema: The innocent joy of childhood friendship before life's complexities set in.
The monotony and ennui of suburban life, seen through the eyes of restless youth.
The intense emotions and uncertainties of first love, knowing it can't last forever.

titulo: The Night We Stole the Sign
tema: Acts of teenage rebellion as a cry for attention and freedom from societal expectations.
The pain of watching friends move away, leaving behind emptiness and memories.
Making promises under the stars that may or may not be kept once reality sets in.
The bittersweet feelings of leaving childhood behind, stepping into adulthood with equal parts excitement and fear.

titulo: Reunion at the Old Oak Tree
tema: Looking back on growing up together, finding comfort in shared memories amidst life's changes.
